fix.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

ex.es: Algunas picaduras de araña pueden ser mortales.
ex.en: Some spider bites can be deadly.

ex.es: Ese veneno es mortal para los gatos.
ex.en: That poison is deadly to cats.

ex.es: Tengo un cansancio mortal después del turno.
ex.en: I'm dead tired after my shift.

notes: mortal: 2nd (colloquial) sense appeared in ex2 as well as ex3; ex2 replaced with the main meaning. All other entries verified correct.
